title: Telecoms operator says its finance chief will leave at year-end
snippet: Safaricom said she would step down on Dec. 31 after six years in the role; the board has begun a search for a successor.
note: Pronouns 'its' and 'she' refer back to Safaricom's CFO.

title: Sasol warns its annual earnings will fall by as much as 40%
snippet: The petrochemicals group said it expected headline earnings per share to drop between 30% and 40%, below consensus, on weaker chemical prices.
note: Profit warning described with 'its'/'it'/'the group'.

title: Wells Fargo says it agreed to pay $250 million to settle OCC enforcement action
snippet: The bank said the regulator found it had failed to fix risk-management deficiencies; it admitted no wrongdoing.
note: Regulator penalty against 'it' = Wells Fargo.

title: Sugar producer says board has voluntarily placed it in business rescue
snippet: Tongaat Hulett said its directors resolved to begin business rescue proceedings after it was unable to reach agreement with lenders on a new funding package.
note: Business rescue of 'it' plus failure to agree funding with lenders (liquidity crisis).

title: Petrolífera estatal angolana diz que renegociou o seu empréstimo com bancos chineses
snippet: A Sonangol afirmou que o novo acordo alonga os prazos de reembolso em cinco anos e reduz as prestações anuais.
note: Portuguese possessive 'seu' and descriptor resolve to Sonangol renegotiating its loan.

title: Peloton says it will swap its 2026 convertible notes for new secured debt
snippet: The fitness company said holders of about 80% of the notes had agreed to the exchange, pushing its nearest maturity out to 2029.
note: Debt exchange of 'its' notes.

title: Egypt's largest private lender says its Q1 profit beat forecasts
snippet: CIB said net profit rose 38% to EGP 16.9 billion, ahead of the EGP 14.8 billion analysts had expected, as its net interest income surged.
note: Descriptor plus 'its' resolve to CIB's earnings beat.

title: FBNH chairman raises stake to 7.6% in fresh share purchases
snippet: Femi Otedola, chairman of the group formerly known as FBN Holdings, bought another 150 million shares, according to an exchange filing.
note: Former name abbreviation FBNH refers to First HoldCo; chairman buying shares.

title: Facebook owner fined 1.2 billion euros by Irish regulator over data transfers
snippet: Ireland's Data Protection Commission said the company had breached EU privacy rules by moving users' data to the United States.
note: 'Facebook owner' is an alias for Meta Platforms.

title: INTC slumps after hours as fourth-quarter outlook misses Street
snippet: The chipmaker forecast revenue of $13.3 billion, short of the $14.2 billion analysts had expected.
note: Ticker-only subject.

title: Former Barclays Africa names interim CEO after chief's abrupt exit
snippet: Absa said its chief executive had left by mutual agreement and that the financial director would act in the role.
note: Former name Barclays Africa refers to Absa Group.

title: ATW : le conseil coopte un nouvel administrateur indépendant
snippet: Le conseil d'administration de la banque a coopté une ancienne dirigeante de Bank Al-Maghrib en remplacement d'un administrateur démissionnaire.
note: Ticker ATW for Attijariwafa bank; director appointed and director resigned.

title: BCP : Fitch abaisse la note à long terme d'un cran
snippet: L'agence de notation justifie la dégradation de la note du groupe bancaire par la hausse des créances en souffrance.
note: Abbreviation BCP refers to Banque Centrale Populaire (Moroccan context).

title: GE raises 2026 profit outlook above Wall Street forecasts
snippet: The jet-engine maker, formerly General Electric, now sees adjusted EPS of $6.40 to $6.60, versus consensus of $6.10.
note: GE / formerly General Electric = GE Aerospace.

title: KPLC breaches loan covenants; auditors flag going-concern doubt
snippet: Kenya Power and Lighting Company said it was in talks with lenders for waivers after its debt service ratio fell below required levels.
note: Ticker-like abbreviation KPLC; covenant breach and going-concern doubt.

title: GTBank parent posts 70% jump in profit, beating analyst forecasts
snippet: GTCO said pre-tax profit for the nine months reached N1.1 trillion, ahead of consensus.
note: 'GTBank parent' and GTCO refer to the holding company target.

title: SHP offloads Nigerian supermarkets to local investor Ketron
snippet: Shoprite said it sold its 100% interest in Retail Supermarkets Nigeria as part of its exit from the market.
note: Ticker SHP; target selling a unit.

title: MTN Nigeria CEO to step down at end of year
snippet: MTN Nigeria Communications said its chief executive would retire; the Johannesburg-based parent has not commented.
note: Leadership change at a separately named subsidiary is not the parent's own event.

title: Orange Mali : l'autorité de régulation inflige une amende pour qualité de service insuffisante
snippet: L'AMRTP reproche à l'opérateur malien, filiale du groupe Sonatel, des coupures répétées du réseau.
note: Fine on a subsidiary (Orange Mali) is not Sonatel's own regulatory action.

title: Attijariwafa bank cède sa filiale congolaise à un consortium local
snippet: Le groupe bancaire marocain a annoncé la vente de la totalité de sa participation dans sa filiale au Congo pour un montant non divulgué.
note: Target selling a subsidiary is its own M&A.

title: Paramount-Skydance merger closes as Shari Redstone exits board
snippet: Redstone, who had been non-executive chair of Paramount Global, stepped down as David Ellison became chief executive of the combined company.
note: Merger completion and chair departure both belong to the target.

title: CBN dissolves boards of Union Bank, Keystone and Polaris over regulatory breaches
snippet: The Central Bank of Nigeria appointed new interim management teams at the three lenders.
note: Target is one of several banks whose boards were dissolved by the regulator.

title: Holcim completes sale of Lafarge Africa stake to Huaxin Cement
snippet: China's Huaxin now holds a controlling 83.8% interest in the Nigerian cement maker.
note: Target's controlling stake changed hands between two other parties.

title: Wema Bank beats forecasts while Sterling misses as Nigerian lenders report
snippet: Sterling's half-year profit came in 18% below analysts' estimates on higher impairment charges.
note: The miss belongs to Sterling; the beat belongs to Wema.

title: Hydrocarbures : le Conseil de la concurrence sanctionne neuf distributeurs dont TotalEnergies Marketing Maroc et Afriquia
snippet: Les sociétés se sont vu infliger des amendes transactionnelles d'un montant total de 1,84 milliard de dirhams.
note: Target is one of several fined distributors.

title: Debt swap extends maturities, cuts annual interest bill by $430 million
snippet: Carvana said holders of 95% of its senior unsecured notes tendered them in its exchange offer for new secured notes.
note: Headline lacks a subject; snippet identifies Carvana's debt exchange.

title: Profit jumps 80%, well ahead of analyst estimates
snippet: GCB Bank said on Thursday that net profit for the nine months to September rose to 1.2 billion cedis.
note: Subjectless headline clarified by snippet.

title: Electronics retailer enters business rescue after lenders pull support
snippet: Ellies Holdings said its board resolved to begin business rescue after it failed to secure new funding and could not pay creditors as they fell due.
note: Generic descriptor in headline; snippet names Ellies and its inability to pay creditors.

title: Chief executive to retire; former executive returns to lead turnaround
snippet: Nike said John Donahoe would step down on Oct. 13 and be replaced by Elliott Hill.
note: Subjectless headline; snippet clarifies Nike.

title: Bénéfice semestriel en hausse de 25 %, au-delà des attentes
snippet: Le sucrier Cosumar a publié un résultat net consolidé supérieur au consensus des analystes, porté par la baisse du prix du sucre brut.
note: French headline without subject; snippet names Cosumar.

title: Accord avec les banques pour rééchelonner 2 milliards de dirhams de dette
snippet: Le promoteur Alliances a conclu avec ses créanciers un allongement de sept ans de la maturité de ses emprunts.
note: Subjectless headline; 'Alliances' in snippet resolves to the target.

title: Regulator suspends trading, orders forensic audit
snippet: Nigeria's Securities and Exchange Commission suspended trading in Oando shares pending a forensic audit of its books.
note: Subjectless headline; snippet identifies regulatory action against Oando.

title: Misses loan repayment to Exim-backed lenders; Treasury steps in
snippet: Kenya Airways failed to make a $45 million instalment, prompting the National Treasury to draw on its guarantee.
note: Missed payment by target revealed only in the snippet.

title: Files for Chapter 11 after failed merger and bondholder talks
snippet: Spirit Airlines filed for bankruptcy with a prearranged plan to swap $795 million of debt for equity; its earlier deal with JetBlue was blocked in January.
note: Bankruptcy and debt-for-equity swap are current; the failed merger is background only.

title: Banco central destitui conselho de administração e nomeia gestão provisória
snippet: O Banco de Moçambique interveio no Moza Banco, alegando deterioração dos indicadores prudenciais.
note: Portuguese subjectless headline; snippet identifies Moza Banco.

title: WBD chief says company is not for sale, shuts down merger chatter
note: Denial of M&A.

title: Starbucks CEO could face pressure to step down if turnaround stalls, analysts say
note: Hypothetical leadership change.

title: Kenya Airways may need debt restructuring if fuel costs stay high, analyst says
note: Conditional speculation, no restructuring under way.

title: Sycamore Partners in talks to take Walgreens private, WSJ reports
snippet: The private-equity firm is negotiating a deal that could be announced in coming weeks, people familiar said.
note: Credibly reported buyout talks.

title: Seplat makes offer for Eni's Nigerian onshore assets, people familiar say
snippet: The bid values the assets at about $700 million, according to two people with knowledge of the matter.
note: Credibly reported offer by the target.

title: Boeing, fined $2.5 billion in 2021 over 737 MAX, unveils new pilot training centre
note: Historical fine is background.

title: ArcelorMittal SA, bailed out by its parent in 2020, swings to surprise profit
snippet: The steelmaker reported headline earnings of R620 million against analyst expectations of a loss.
note: Past bailout is background; surprise profit is current.

title: Nampak, which completed debt restructuring and rights offer in 2023, resumes dividend
note: Past restructuring is background.

title: JPMorgan, which bought First Republic in 2023, beats third-quarter profit estimates
note: Past acquisition is background; earnings beat is current.

title: Hertz, which emerged from bankruptcy in 2021, names new finance chief
note: Past bankruptcy is background; CFO appointment is current.

title: Wolfspeed files for Chapter 11 with plan to cut $4.6 billion of debt
note: Bankruptcy filing with debt restructuring plan.

title: SEC charges Nikola with defrauding investors
note: Direct regulatory action.

title: Addoha lance un avertissement sur ses résultats annuels
snippet: Le promoteur prévoit un résultat net inférieur de plus de 30 % à celui de l'exercice précédent.
note: Profit warning.

title: Coronation CEO buys R5 million worth of company shares
note: Officer share purchase.

title: Starboard takes stake in Autodesk, plans proxy fight
note: Activist stake.

title: BNA coloca Banco Económico sob intervenção e suspende conselho de administração
snippet: O Banco Nacional de Angola nomeou uma comissão administrativa provisória.
note: Regulator intervention and board suspension.

title: Ezz Steel reports surprise quarterly loss, missing forecasts
note: Earnings miss.

title: Notore misses bond coupon, opens talks with creditors to restructure debt
note: Missed payment plus creditor negotiation.

title: Microsoft rival Salesforce names new chief financial officer
note: Leadership change belongs to Salesforce.
